text:
Burn of the second

on the whole tender little head of desire,

sting of wandering chili pepper,

at two in the immoral afternoon.


Glove of the edges, edge to edge.

Fragrant truth touched live, when connecting

the antenna of sex

with what we are being without knowing it.


Washwater of maximum ablution.

Traveling boilers

that collide and splash fresh shadow

unanimous, the color, the fraction, hard life,

                           hard eternal life.

Let us not fear. Death is like this.


The sex, blood of the beloved, which complains,

sweetened, of bearing so much

for so ridiculous a point.

And the circuit

between our poor day and the great night,

at two in the immoral afternoon.

translation.title: Trilce: Poem XXX - Burn of the Second
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the erotic circuit, technical vocabulary, and repeated immoral afternoon.
